accountsettings_erase_failed: The account could not be erased.
accountsettings_erase_description: Deletes the account and everything it owns. This cannot be undone from here.
accountsettings_started: Erasure has started. You are signed out, and this account cannot sign in again.
accountsettings_started_detail: Documents and their files are removed after a recovery window the operator sets; your comments elsewhere stay on the documents they were left on, relabelled “Deleted user” and no longer linked to you.
accountsettings_consequence_projects: Every project you own is deleted, with its files, comments, labels and share links.
accountsettings_consequence_comments: Comments you left on other people's documents stay there, relabelled “Deleted user” and no longer linked to this account.
accountsettings_consequence_record: The account record — provider, handle, name and email — is deleted once its documents are gone.
accountsettings_consequence_signout: You are signed out immediately and cannot sign in again, so nothing here can call it off. Only the operator can, and only before the deletion runs.
accountsettings_handle_aria: Type your handle to confirm erasure
agentsettings_fetches: Downloads its adapter each time you use it.
agentsettings_install_hint: To install it for good, run {command}.
agentsettings_name_required: Enter a name and a command.
agentsettings_list_description: Coding agents installed on this computer, used from the sidebar.
agentsettings_form_hint: Name, then the program and its arguments as typed in a terminal.
agentsettings_desktop_description: Chat with Claude, Codex or another coding agent that reads and edits this project.
buildsettings_description: Automatic reads a % !TEX program line, then the packages the document loads.
defaultpreview_description_latex: Every LaTeX document opens on this preview. View > HTML and View > PDF switch it until you leave the project.
defaultpreview_description_typst: Every Typst document opens on this preview. View > HTML and View > PDF switch it until you leave the project.
defaultpreview_description_markdown: Every Markdown document opens on this preview. View > HTML and View > PDF switch it until you leave the project.
defaultpreview_description_quarto: Every Quarto document opens on this preview. View > HTML and View > PDF switch it until you leave the project.
generalsettings_preview_paper_descriptio: Dark mode can show HTML previews on dark paper. Always light shows the page as readers of the exported HTML see it.
generalsettings_close_description: With the tray, LibrePaper keeps running after its last window closes.
generalsettings_close_failed: The desktop app could not save that.
latexfilessettings_measuring: Measuring… Cached compiler files speed up PDF builds. Removing them keeps your documents.
latexfilessettings_empty: Nothing downloaded yet. Cached compiler files speed up PDF builds. Removing them keeps your documents.
latexfilessettings_used: Storage used: {size}. Cached compiler files speed up PDF builds. Removing them keeps your documents.
remotesettings_connected: This server syncs the shared project with collaborators.
remotesettings_retrying: Connection retries while this page is open.
renderersettings_description: {name} documents render in this browser, or on this computer while Run code is on.
renderersettings_note: The tool may download packages on its own.
toolcommand_help: {input} is the main file and {stem} is its path without the extension. The command runs in the folder that holds the project files.
toolcommand_no_command: The desktop app has no command for this output.
toolcommand_load_failed: Could not load the desktop app settings.
toolcommand_confirm_dialog: Confirm the change in the dialog on this computer.
toolssettings_desktop_description: Render documents with the programs on your computer, run their code locally.
toolssettings_zotero_open: Open Zotero and allow other applications to communicate with it (Zotero settings, Advanced).
toolssettings_install: Install {title} on this computer, then rescan.
